consequence.statement: If the removed shared-store setting did not match object_store for periods using boltdb-shipper, access to the index for those periods is lost.
consequence.remediation: Move or copy the index tables to the store configured in object_store, and remove the deleted option.

assertion.statement: The -boltdb.shipper.shared-store option is removed; if it was set to a value differing from object_store for boltdb-shipper periods, the index for those periods becomes inaccessible until tables are moved or copied to the object_store store.

checks.detail: the subject and change are not both confirmed by an artifact validator
